description: Meld language-composition compiler, CLI and language server
post_install: if (Test-Path "$dir\share\doc\meld-lang\README.md") { Write-Host 'meld-lang: licenses and docs are in share\doc\meld-lang' }
notes: The checked-in hash must come from the signed release SHA256SUMS before this manifest is published; do not publish an unverified hash.

Automatic version updates are disabled: no autoupdate/checkver source is trusted to supply a hash without cosign verification. Update hashes with tools/generate_channel_metadata.py after a signed release.
MELD_ROOT points at the bundled Lang Packs; no language runtime is installed.
